meta.title: Lease Loop
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Prices are today's list prices, net of VAT. Pick an item to choose your term and down payment.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.
condition.label: Condition
status.label: Status
contract.title: Signed contract
contract.rule: The net price locks when you sign, using the price list valid on the signing date. Earlier quotes are estimates. Later catalogue changes do not change your agreed net rent.
contract.error: Signing failed. Refresh to review the current price and availability, then try again.
contract.tax: VAT is added at the rate on each invoice date. A tax change can change your total while your net rent stays locked.
catalogue.noMatches: No items match these filters. Try removing one.
sort.name: Name: A to Z
filters.title: Filters
filters.termHint: Longer leases can lower the monthly rent on some items. The exact price is shown on the item page.
item.applyNote: Applying takes about 5 minutes. You will see your price again before you sign.
item.reserved: This item is reserved for another customer and cannot be leased right now.
item.notFound: We could not find this item.
lease.buyout: Buyout at the end of the lease: {amount}
lease.startsOn: Lease starting {date}. The price updates as you move the sliders.
lease.tooCheap: This item costs less than {min}, the smallest amount we can lease, so it cannot be leased.
lease.needsDown: We can finance at most {max}. This item needs a down payment of at least {down}.
lease.unavailable: We cannot price this lease. Try another term or down payment.
compare.toggle: Compare all terms side by side
compare.caption: The same item and down payment over each term
explain.title: Explain my price
explain.buyout: Buyout at the end of the term
explain.totalHint: Down payment plus {months} monthly rents, before VAT. Buying the item at the end is optional and not included.
explain.formula: Monthly rent = financed amount × monthly factor. The factor depends on the amount and the term, and already includes interest. Each amount is rounded once to the nearest cent; half a cent rounds up.
explain.vatChange: VAT is charged at the rate on each invoice date. It changes to {rate} % on {date}, so later invoices are higher even though your net rent stays the same.
explain.vatSame: VAT is charged at the rate on each invoice date.
